heading: Is it the right time to buy HDFC Bank shares? Stock gains 4% in September, set to snap 2-month losing run
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: After a significant drop, HDFC Bank shares have gained over 4% in September, prompting questions about potential recovery. Experts weigh in on technical levels and long-term investment opportunities amidst concerns of past underperformance and stable fundamentals.&nbsp;
